automatic: request Save Code Now after verified Codeberg update

zenodo.role: research-software deposit, versioned research record and DOI
automatic: create a draft when authorised credentials are present and no matching draft exists

datacite.role: DOI metadata graph, discovery and optional direct DOI registration
conditional: direct DOI creation/update requires a DataCite Repository account or API key tied to one
datacite.preferredPath: use Zenodo DOI unless a direct DataCite Repository integration is deliberately enabled

openaire.role: research discovery graph and linkage to grants, organisations and outputs
automatic: record OpenAIRE graph identifier when discovered
openaire.depositStrategy: prefer trusted-source harvesting through Zenodo/DataCite rather than duplicate direct deposit

automatic: read public record when API credentials exist
conditional: writing works/funding/affiliations requires ORCID Member API and the record holder's OAuth permission
humanGate: one-time OAuth authorisation if automatic ORCID write is to be enabled

mustNot: publish irreversible records without explicit gate
